sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举办的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领袖，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、扎伊兰·蒙达尼以及其他许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话实况。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在nytimes.com上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Today, a teenage boy who dressed like a girl was murdered in an Iowa town.
sentences.zh: 今天，爱荷华州一个小镇发生了一起谋杀案，受害者是一名打扮成女孩的少年。

sentences.en: Now the Trump administration is deciding whether the boy was killed simply for being himself.
sentences.zh: 现在，特朗普政府正在判定这名少年是否仅仅因为做自己而遭到了杀害。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, November 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月8日，星期三。

sentences.en: There was a trial that began last week in a town in southeast Iowa, and it was a murder trial in a case involving a teenager, a 16-year-old, who was named Kadari Johnson.
sentences.zh: 上周，爱荷华州东南部的一个小镇开始了一场审判，这是一起涉及一名16岁少年卡达里·约翰逊的谋杀案审判。

sentences.en: Monica Davey has been covering the case.
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡·戴维一直在报道此案。

sentences.en: May it please the court, your honor, counsel, and ladies and gentlemen of the jury.
sentences.zh: 法官大人、律师，以及陪审团的女士们、先生们，请允许我陈述。

sentences.en: Kadari Johnson was a friendly high school student with a bright future,
sentences.zh: 卡达里·约翰逊曾是一名友善的高中生，有着光明的前途，

sentences.en: but that future was stolen from him.
sentences.zh: 但那个未来却被从他手中夺走了。

sentences.en: On March 2nd of last year, Kadari Johnson was kidnapped,
sentences.zh: 去年3月2日，卡达里·约翰逊遭到绑架，

sentences.en: suffocated, and then executed.
sentences.zh: 窒息而死，随后被处决。

sentences.en: Kadari had been shot twice in the chest with a rare kind of gun, a .357 caliber revolver.
sentences.zh: 卡达里的胸部被一种罕见的枪支——.357口径左轮手枪——近距离射击了两次。

sentences.en: He had last been seen alive a few hours earlier, being followed by two men in a red Chevy Impala.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，有人最后一次见到他还活着，当时他正被两名驾驶红色雪佛兰Impala的男子跟踪。

sentences.en: One of those men had recently purchased him.
sentences.zh: 其中一名男子最近刚买下了他。

sentences.en: The killing took place in this small community of Burlington, Iowa, and it's sort of on a hill right up against the Mississippi River.
sentences.zh: 这起杀戮发生在爱荷华州伯灵顿这个小社区，它坐落在密西西比河边的一座小山上。

sentences.en: It's mostly white.
sentences.zh: 这里大部分是白人。

sentences.en: It's an old manufacturing town, and it has that feel, you know, especially at this time of year.
sentences.zh: 这是一个老旧的制造业城镇，你知道，尤其是在每年的这个时候，它有一种独特的氛围。

sentences.en: It's got that cold, sort of chilly but old feeling of an Iowa town.
sentences.zh: 它有一种爱荷华州小镇特有的寒冷、阴郁但古老的感觉。

sentences.en: Later that night, they asked a friend to hold on to the murder weapon, that rare .357 caliber revolver.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，他们让一个朋友保管凶器，那把罕见的.357口径左轮手枪。

sentences.en: But despite those and other efforts by the defendants, they left behind a trail of evidence that would ultimately lead to their capture.
sentences.zh: 但尽管被告做了这些以及其他努力，他们还是留下了一连串证据，最终导致他们被捕。

sentences.en: That's how this story ends.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个故事的结局。

sentences.en: The story begins with Kadari Johnson.
sentences.zh: 故事要从卡达里·约翰逊说起。

sentences.en: Monica, who was Kadari Johnson?
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡，卡达里·约翰逊是个什么样的人？

sentences.en: For one, he was one of a kind.
sentences.zh: 首先，他是独一无二的。

sentences.en: You really couldn't find nobody else like him.
sentences.zh: 你真的找不到第二个像他这样的人了。

sentences.en: And he was a person who stood out, you know.
sentences.zh: 他是一个很显眼的人，你知道的。

sentences.en: So Kadari Johnson, he's African American.
sentences.zh: 卡达里·约翰逊是非裔美国人。

sentences.en: His family came from Chicago.
sentences.zh: 他的家人来自芝加哥。

sentences.en: Befriend to anyone who talked to him who wanted to be his friend because he was just like that cool of a person.
sentences.zh: 他与任何想和他交朋友的人都能成为朋友，因为他就是那种很酷的人。

sentences.en: He gave off that aroma.
sentences.zh: 他散发着那种魅力。

sentences.en: He'll always like do something to make you smile.
sentences.zh: 他总会做些什么让你微笑。

sentences.en: He was very popular.
sentences.zh: 他非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: He has this gorgeous gleaming smile.
sentences.zh: 他有着灿烂夺目的笑容。

sentences.en: He was the kind of guy who if you just say the name Kadari near Burlington High School, everybody knows Kadari.
sentences.zh: 他是那种在伯灵顿高中只要提到“卡达里”这个名字，每个人都知道是谁的人。

sentences.en: He's one of those people that once you meet him, you'd never forget him.
sentences.zh: 他是那种一旦你见过，就永远不会忘记的人。

sentences.en: I talked to some of the people who knew Kadari the best in
sentences.zh: 我采访了一些在伯灵顿最了解卡达里的人。

sentences.en: Burlington.
sentences.zh: 伯灵顿。

sentences.en: One of them was Shonda Campbell.
sentences.zh: 其中一位是肖达·坎贝尔。

sentences.en: She was a counselor at the school.
sentences.zh: 她是学校的一名辅导员。

sentences.en: Kadari would not go to class.
sentences.zh: 卡达里经常不去上课。

sentences.en: He liked to be the center of attention.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢成为关注的焦点。

sentences.en: She told me that he was sometimes a troublemaker.
sentences.zh: 她告诉我，他有时是个捣蛋鬼。

sentences.en: He was goofing around.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢胡闹。

sentences.en: He was dancing in the halls.
sentences.zh: 他在走廊里跳舞。

sentences.en: Then we had this two-way mirror and he would sit and dance in that mirror all day to keep himself busy because like I said, he was just so full of energy and so full of life.
sentences.zh: 当时我们有一面双面镜，他会整天坐在镜子前跳舞来打发时间，因为就像我说的，他充满了活力和生命力。

sentences.en: He would dance behind teachers when they didn't know he was dancing.
sentences.zh: 当老师们不知道的时候，他会在他们身后跳舞。

sentences.en: It was a sort of shenanigans that made the other kids love him and laugh.
sentences.zh: 正是这种恶作剧让其他孩子爱他并为之发笑。

sentences.en: Probably the sorts of things that really annoy teachers.
sentences.zh: 可能也是那些真正让老师感到恼火的事情。

sentences.en: There was one unique thing about Kadari and that was that he one day came to school in women's clothing and that was that.
sentences.zh: 卡达里有一件独特的事情，那就是有一天他穿着女装来学校，事情就是这样。

sentences.en: The first time I ever saw him dressed, I remember I was sitting at my desk and he walked past me and he said, hey Shonda, and I looked up.
sentences.zh: 我第一次看到他那样打扮时，记得我正坐在办公桌前，他从我身边走过，说：“嘿，肖达”，我抬起头。

sentences.en: She sort of did a double take.
sentences.zh: 她当时有点不敢相信自己的眼睛。

sentences.en: And my other, the other ladies in my office were like, was that Kadari that just went through here, you know?
sentences.zh: 我办公室里的其他女士问：“刚才走过去的是卡达里吗？”

sentences.en: And I'm like, yeah, I believe it was him.
sentences.zh: 我说：“是的，我想是他。”

sentences.en: So then he'd come back an hour later and he just said, he's sitting in front of my desk and he had this infectious laugh that he did.
sentences.zh: 一小时后他回来了，坐在我桌前，发出了那种极具感染力的笑声。

sentences.en: And he laughed out loud.
sentences.zh: 他大声地笑了出来。

sentences.en: And the three of us looked at each other, the other office ladies, and we just laughed along with him.
sentences.zh: 我们三个人面面相觑，办公室里的其他女士也跟着他一起笑了起来。

sentences.en: It was unusual in this community.
sentences.zh: 在这个社区里这很不寻常。

sentences.en: On the other hand, they kind of got used to it.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，他们也习惯了。

sentences.en: They just got used to it.
sentences.zh: 他们只是习惯了。

sentences.en: It was just Kadari.
sentences.zh: 他就是卡达里。

sentences.en: So how did he like to dress?
sentences.zh: 那么他喜欢怎么打扮？

sentences.en: He especially liked maxi dresses and maxi skirts.
sentences.zh: 他特别喜欢长裙和长裙摆。

sentences.en: He loved to wear hair extensions.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢戴接发。

sentences.en: Like dresses or, yeah, hair man.
sentences.zh: 比如裙子，或者，是的，头发。

sentences.en: He loved headbands.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢发带。

sentences.en: Different colors of headbands.
sentences.zh: 各种颜色的发带。

sentences.en: What colors did he particularly love?
sentences.zh: 他特别喜欢什么颜色？

sentences.en: Pink, purple, floral, flowers, orange, that type of stuff.
sentences.zh: 粉色、紫色、花卉图案、花朵、橙色，诸如此类的东西。

sentences.en: The teachers like to say that he spent time in the girls' bathroom teaching girls how to put on false
sentences.zh: 老师们常说他花时间在女厕所教女孩们如何贴假睫毛，

sentences.en: eyelashes, how to do their makeup better, how to use a flat iron on their hair.
sentences.zh: 如何更好地化妆，如何用直发夹板打理头发。

sentences.en: Did he borrow things from you?
sentences.zh: 他会向你借东西吗？

sentences.en: Did he borrow clothes ever?
sentences.zh: 他借过衣服吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, he came over like leggings or bras, that type of stuff.
sentences.zh: 是的，他会过来借紧身裤或胸罩之类的东西。

sentences.en: Shonda Campbell, she, I think she even just called a girl talk.
sentences.zh: 肖达·坎贝尔，我想她甚至把这称为“女孩间的谈话”。

sentences.en: I would say something like, you need a better pair of shoes if you're going to wear that skirt.
sentences.zh: 我会说些类似的话，比如：“如果你要穿那条裙子，你需要一双更好的鞋子。”

sentences.en: I feel like he was just doing him.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他只是在做他自己。

sentences.en: He was being him.
sentences.zh: 他在做他自己。

sentences.en: He was doing what he wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 他在做他想做的事。

sentences.en: And I don't think he would have changed from nowhere.
sentences.zh: 我不认为他会因为任何原因而改变。

sentences.en: So if the town loved him like this, what happened?
sentences.zh: 既然这个小镇这么爱他，那到底发生了什么？

sentences.en: That's the awful thing about this story.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个故事最可怕的地方。

sentences.en: I went to the Maple Leaf Center, which was a community center where Kadari spent a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 我去了枫叶中心，那是一个卡达里经常待的社区中心。

sentences.en: It was a place where he did homework.
sentences.zh: 那是他做作业的地方。

sentences.en: It was a place where he hung out with his friends.
sentences.zh: 那是他和朋友们消磨时光的地方。

sentences.en: And I went there last week, one night, and one of the people that I met was Tramiel Jones, who was 17 and was a really close friend of Kadari's.
sentences.zh: 上周的一天晚上我去了那里，遇到的人之一是17岁的特拉米尔·琼斯，他是卡达里非常亲密的朋友。

sentences.en: He says his best friend, but then a lot of people say they're his best friend.
sentences.zh: 他说他是卡达里的挚友，但很多人都说自己是他的挚友。

sentences.en: Tramiel was really, really hurt by what had happened and was really close with Kadari.
sentences.zh: 特拉米尔对发生的事情感到非常非常痛苦，他和卡达里关系真的很近。

sentences.en: I miss everything about him, but if I can take one thing, it's just hearing his voice.
sentences.zh: 我怀念关于他的一切，但如果我能带走一样东西，那就是听到他的声音。

sentences.en: What was his voice like?
sentences.zh: 他的声音是什么样的？

sentences.en: Tell me about his voice.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说他的声音。

sentences.en: So on March 2nd, 2016, Kadari Johnson was hanging out with his friends.
sentences.zh: 2016年3月2日，卡达里·约翰逊正和朋友们在一起。

sentences.en: They went to the library at one point, and then they went up to the Hy-Vee, which is a grocery store.
sentences.zh: 他们先去了图书馆，然后去了Hy-Vee，那是一家杂货店。

sentences.en: And the reason that
sentences.zh: 卡达里和他的朋友们喜欢去那里的原因是，

sentences.en: Kadari and his friends liked to go there was because they could get free Wi-Fi by sitting in the, like, the cafe area of the Hy-Vee.
sentences.zh: 他们可以通过坐在Hy-Vee的咖啡区使用免费Wi-Fi。

sentences.en: So they went up there.
sentences.zh: 所以他们去了那里。

sentences.en: And how was he dressed that night?
sentences.zh: 那天晚上他穿得怎么样？

sentences.en: He had on some leggings.
sentences.zh: 他穿着紧身裤。

sentences.en: I think he had on a little jacket or whatever he had on.
sentences.zh: 我想他穿了一件小夹克之类的东西。

sentences.en: He was wearing really long hair extensions, and he had on a hot pink headband around his hair, and he had leggings, and he was dressed like a girl.
sentences.zh: 他戴着很长的接发，头上戴着一条亮粉色的发带，穿着紧身裤，打扮得像个女孩。

sentences.en: And you can see video images of Tramiel and of Kadari, you know, walking out of the Hy-Vee that night after they were done getting their Wi-Fi.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到特拉米尔和卡达里的视频图像，你知道，那天晚上他们用完Wi-Fi后走出Hy-Vee。

sentences.en: And actually, Kadari was kind of dancing his way out of the Hy-Vee.
sentences.zh: 事实上，卡达里走出Hy-Vee时还在跳舞。

sentences.en: You know, when you're writing about someone that you really don't ever get to meet and you just hear about him, I felt like I
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你写一个你从未见过、只是听说过的人时，在那一刻我感觉我好像认识他，

sentences.en: kind of knew him in that moment because Tramiel walks out of the store first, and he looks sort of somber and aloof like most teenage boys do walking out of places.
sentences.zh: 因为特拉米尔先走出商店，他看起来有点忧郁和冷漠，就像大多数青少年走出某个地方时那样。

sentences.en: He looked sort of nonchalant and aloof.
sentences.zh: 他看起来有点漫不经心和冷漠。

sentences.en: And Kadari looked sort of joyous and kind of throwing up his hands and like doing a little
sentences.zh: 而卡达里看起来很欢乐，他挥舞着双手，好像在跳一段小舞。

sentences.en: dance almoSt. And you kind of got a sense he's a person who was, you know, living life in a big way, even in that moment walking out of a grocery store.
sentences.zh: 你会感觉到他是一个即使在走出杂货店的那一刻，也在尽情享受生活的人。

sentences.en: It's only a matter of two hours between the time that he's at the grocery store and that his body is found.
sentences.zh: 从他在杂货店到被发现尸体，中间只有两个小时。

sentences.en: Monica, how was he found?
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡，他是怎么被发现的？

sentences.en: His body was found in some tall brush in a really narrow alley behind some houses a bunch of blocks away.
sentences.zh: 他的尸体是在几条街外一些房子后面一条非常狭窄的小巷里的高草丛中被发现的。

sentences.en: He had a bag tied around his head.
sentences.zh: 他的头上绑着一个袋子。

sentences.en: He had a plastic bag in his mouth as if it had been someone was trying to suffocate him.
sentences.zh: 他的嘴里塞着一个塑料袋，好像有人试图让他窒息。

sentences.en: And he had two gunshot wounds to his cheSt. His shirt was pulled up so you could see his bra.
sentences.zh: 他的胸部有两处枪伤。他的衬衫被拉起来，露出了里面的胸罩。

sentences.en: His shoes were off.
sentences.zh: 他的鞋子不见了。

sentences.en: He was barefoot on this really frozen night in March in 2016.
sentences.zh: 在2016年3月那个寒冷的夜晚，他是赤脚的。

sentences.en: And there was a bottle of bleach.
sentences.zh: 旁边还有一瓶漂白剂。

sentences.en: The prosecutors say his body was doused in bleach as if someone was trying to cover up DNA evidence or other evidence on his body.
sentences.zh: 检察官说他的尸体被漂白剂浸泡过，好像有人试图掩盖他身上的DNA证据或其他证据。

sentences.en: So he's covered in bleach.
sentences.zh: 所以他身上全是漂白剂。

sentences.en: And there's a bleach bottle just left beside his body.
sentences.zh: 旁边就留着一瓶漂白剂。

sentences.en: So it was a very horrific, horrific scene.
sentences.zh: 那是一个非常可怕、非常可怕的现场。

sentences.en: The day after his death, the school basically stopped.
sentences.zh: 在他去世后的第二天，学校基本上停课了。

sentences.en: People were hearing this in the halls and going to the office.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在走廊里听到这个消息，纷纷涌向办公室。

sentences.en: And there basically was not school that day because kids were so upset and spent the whole day wandering around the halls, they said, hugging each other and talking to each
sentences.zh: 那天基本上没法上课，因为孩子们太难过了，他们说整天都在走廊里徘徊，互相拥抱，谈论着卡达里。

sentences.en: other and talking about Qadari.
sentences.zh: 谈论着卡达里。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: I just want to figure out what happened at night.
sentences.zh: 我只是想弄清楚那天晚上发生了什么。

sentences.en: That's all I want to know is what happened at night.
sentences.zh: 我只想知道那天晚上到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: The truth is that what happened and the motive behind it have been largely kept out of view since this happened back in 2016.
sentences.zh: 事实是，自2016年这件事发生以来，到底发生了什么以及背后的动机在很大程度上一直不为人知。

sentences.en: And the suggestion by prosecutors during this trial has been that these two men in their 20s thought that Qadari was a cute girl, a cute high school girl,
sentences.zh: 检察官在审判期间的说法是，这两名20多岁的男子认为卡达里是一个可爱的女孩，一个可爱的高中女生，

sentences.en: and were interested in her.
sentences.zh: 并对她产生了兴趣。

sentences.en: It's been sort of ambiguous as to whether they propositioned him or they just straight out kidnapped him to sexually assault him.
sentences.zh: 至于他们是向他求爱，还是直接绑架他进行性侵犯，一直有些模糊不清。

sentences.en: That's the idea that prosecutors have presented, that somewhere they discover that he's actually male and they are enraged by this and they kill him.
sentences.zh: 这就是检察官提出的观点，即他们在某个地方发现他实际上是男性，因此感到愤怒并杀害了他。

sentences.en: So, Monica, was this a hate crime?
sentences.zh: 那么，莫妮卡，这是一起仇恨犯罪吗？

sentences.en: That's a really complicated question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常复杂的问题。

sentences.en: It's a complicated legal question, among other things.
sentences.zh: 除其他事项外，这是一个复杂的法律问题。

sentences.en: So, in Iowa, the two defendants are not charged with hate crimes.
sentences.zh: 在爱荷华州，这两名被告并未被控仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: They're charged with first-degree murder.
sentences.zh: 他们被控一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: But under Iowa law, hate crime charges do not cover gender identity.
sentences.zh: 但在爱荷华州法律下，仇恨犯罪指控并不涵盖性别认同。

sentences.en: And in fact, last year, there was an effort to add gender identity to the state hate crime statute, and it failed in the Iowa House.
sentences.zh: 事实上，去年曾有人努力将性别认同加入州仇恨犯罪法规，但在爱荷华州众议院失败了。

sentences.en: So were people in the town disappointed about that?
sentences.zh: 那么镇上的人对此感到失望吗？

sentences.en: I mean, that this couldn't be treated as a hate crime?
sentences.zh: 我是说，因为这不能被视为仇恨犯罪？

sentences.en: Was that something that upset people?
sentences.zh: 这让人们感到不安吗？

sentences.en: His mom, Katrina Johnson, she believes this is a hate crime.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲卡特里娜·约翰逊认为这是一起仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: I mean, the important thing to know about her, too, is that she was really, really supportive of Qadari.
sentences.zh: 关于她，有一点很重要，那就是她真的非常支持卡达里。

sentences.en: They talked about who he was and how he wanted to dress and how he wanted to act, and they were really open about it as a family.
sentences.zh: 他们一家人会谈论他是谁，他想怎么穿衣，想怎么行事，他们对此非常坦诚。

sentences.en: She said that she saw herself as his twin.
sentences.zh: 她说她把卡达里看作自己的双胞胎。

sentences.en: They often would, you know, get dressed up together and, you know, do each other's makeup and, you know, take selfies and hang out.
sentences.zh: 他们经常会一起打扮，互相化妆，一起自拍，一起出去玩。

sentences.en: I think it's really personally painful to her, but on some bigger level, I think she feels incredibly strongly that
sentences.zh: 我认为这对她个人来说非常痛苦，但在更高层面上，我认为她强烈地感觉到

sentences.en: this needs to be considered a hate crime to send some larger signal even beyond Qadari's life.
sentences.zh: 这必须被视为仇恨犯罪，以发出超越卡达里生命本身的更广泛的信号。

sentences.en: In the Iowa District Court for Des Moines County, the state of Iowa plaintiff versus Jorge L.
sentences.zh: 在得梅因县的爱荷华州地方法院，爱荷华州原告诉豪尔赫·L·

sentences.en: Sanders-Galvez, charged jointly with Jerron and Perham, defendant.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯-加尔韦斯，与杰伦和珀汉共同被控，被告。

sentences.en: So even though Iowa could not charge these two men with hate crimes, and even as the town was getting
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管爱荷华州无法以仇恨犯罪起诉这两名男子，甚至在小镇准备

sentences.en: ready for the trials that we were going to see with the first-degree murder charges against these two men, something really surprising happened.
sentences.zh: 迎接我们将要看到的针对这两名男子的蓄意谋杀罪审判时，发生了一件非常令人惊讶的事情。

sentences.en: Suddenly, a federal prosecutor arrives in town to begin pursuing this case as a possible federal hate crime.
sentences.zh: 突然，一名联邦检察官来到镇上，开始将此案作为可能的联邦仇恨犯罪进行追诉。

sentences.en: One of the men in that red Impala,
sentences.zh: 那辆红色英帕拉车里的其中一人，

sentences.en: one of the men responsible for Qadari's abduction and murder, is that man, the defendant,
sentences.zh: 对卡达里被绑架和谋杀负有责任的其中一人，就是那个人，被告，

sentences.en: Jorge Sanders-Galvez.
sentences.zh: 豪尔赫·桑德斯-加尔韦斯。
zh_words: 豪尔赫·桑德斯-加尔韦斯

sentences.en: Even more unusual is not only do you have the federal investigators looking at the possibility of federal charges, federal hate crime charges, but you also have
sentences.zh: 更不寻常的是，不仅有联邦调查人员在研究联邦指控、联邦仇恨犯罪指控的可能性，而且你还有

sentences.en: this federal prosecutor being really deeply involved in the local prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这位联邦检察官深度参与了地方起诉工作。

sentences.en: He did the opening statement.
sentences.zh: 他做了开庭陈述。

sentences.en: Let's start with how Qadari was dressed.
sentences.zh: 让我们从卡达里的着装开始说起。

sentences.en: You'll see on that Hy-Vee video that Qadari was dressed like a girl.
sentences.zh: 你会看到那段Hy-Vee监控视频中，卡达里打扮得像个女孩。

sentences.en: He had tight black leggings on, had his nails painted pink, had a pink headband, and long hair extensions to make him look like a female.
sentences.zh: 他穿着紧身黑色打底裤，指甲涂成粉红色，戴着粉色发带，还留着长发接发，让自己看起来像个女性。

sentences.en: He is a specialist in this, and that's what he was there to do, to look at this as a possible hate crime.
sentences.zh: 他是这方面的专家，他来这里就是为了做这件事，即从可能的仇恨犯罪角度来审视此案。

sentences.en: And females?
sentences.zh: 还有女性？

sentences.en: That was one thing the defendant and Jerron were into.
sentences.zh: 那是被告和杰伦感兴趣的一点。

sentences.en: And he's actually been sent by the Attorney General, Jeff Sessions.
sentences.zh: 他实际上是由司法部长杰夫·塞申斯派来的。

sentences.en: We really don't know why he's pursuing this case in particular.
sentences.zh: 我们真的不知道他为什么要特别追究这个案子。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Matt Apuzzo, how did the Department of Justice first find out about this case?
sentences.zh: 马特·阿普佐，司法部最初是如何发现这个案子的？

sentences.en: You have to go back to earlier this year.
sentences.zh: 你得回到今年早些时候。

sentences.en: A group of lawmakers sent Jeff Sessions a letter, and the letter said, we're really concerned because just in your tenure at the Justice Department,
sentences.zh: 一群议员给杰夫·塞申斯写了一封信，信中说，我们真的很担心，因为就在你担任司法部长期间，

sentences.en: there have been several homicides of transgender women.
sentences.zh: 已经发生了几起针对跨性别女性的谋杀案。

sentences.en: We feel like that might be going unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得这些案件可能没有受到重视。

sentences.en: And Sessions actually calls in a senior career official from the Civil Rights Division and says, well, what do we know about these cases?
sentences.zh: 塞申斯实际上召集了民权部门的一位资深职业官员，问道，关于这些案件我们知道些什么？

sentences.en: And the Civil Rights Guide says, well, you know, here's kind of what we do.
sentences.zh: 民权部门的向导说，嗯，你知道，我们通常是这样做的。

sentences.en: We keep an eye on these cases.
sentences.zh: 我们密切关注这些案件。

sentences.en: We see what coverage bubbles up in the media.
sentences.zh: 我们观察媒体上出现了哪些报道。

sentences.en: And if there's an obvious sign that gender identity was the motive here, then we might open an investigation or we might reach out to the locals and see what they have.
sentences.zh: 如果这里有明显的迹象表明性别认同是动机，那么我们可能会展开调查，或者我们会联系当地部门看看他们有什么线索。

sentences.en: And Sessions said, well, maybe that's not good enough.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯说，嗯，也许这还不够好。

sentences.en: And said, I'd like you to go back and look at these open homicides involving transgender victims and see if we need to get involved.
sentences.zh: 并说，我希望你们回去重新审视这些涉及跨性别受害者的未结谋杀案，看看我们是否需要介入。

sentences.en: And through that effort, the Justice Department came upon this case in Iowa involving Qadari's murder.
sentences.zh: 通过这一努力，司法部发现了这起发生在爱荷华州涉及卡达里谋杀的案件。

sentences.en: Sessions is defying his own image on civil rights by helping in a transgender case.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯通过帮助处理一起跨性别案件，正在打破他在民权问题上的固有形象。

sentences.en: It's being called an unusual move, apparently in support of transgender rights.
sentences.zh: 这被称为一个不寻常的举动，显然是在支持跨性别者的权利。

sentences.en: Sessions has sent a federal hate crimes lawyer to Iowa to help.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯已经派了一名联邦仇恨犯罪律师到爱荷华州提供帮助。

sentences.en: I think people will be surprised to hear that the Department of Justice under Jeff Sessions,
sentences.zh: 我想人们会惊讶地听到，在杰夫·塞申斯领导下的司法部，

sentences.en: this very conservative attorney general, is intervening in a state-level murder involving gender identity.
sentences.zh: 这位非常保守的司法部长，正在介入一起涉及性别认同的州级谋杀案。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And I can absolutely see why that would and did catch people by surprise.
sentences.zh: 我完全明白为什么这会让人感到惊讶，也确实让人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Going back to when
sentences.zh: 回到

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions was a senator from Alabama, he was opposed to expanding federal hate crimes protection based on gender identity.
sentences.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯担任阿拉巴马州参议员时，他曾反对扩大基于性别认同的联邦仇恨犯罪保护。

sentences.en: Arguing against the hate crimes law in 2009, he said this, today, I'm not sure women or people with different sexual orientations face that kind of discrimination.
sentences.zh: 在2009年反对仇恨犯罪法时，他曾说，今天，我不确定女性或不同性取向的人是否面临那种歧视。

sentences.en: I just don't see it.
sentences.zh: 我只是没看出来。

sentences.en: End quote.
sentences.zh: 引语结束。

sentences.en: Well, this senator regretfully sees it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这位参议员现在遗憾地看出来了。

sentences.en: And in fact, when Sessions was up for confirmation, the outpouring of opposition from the civil rights groups was pretty significant.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当塞申斯接受确认听证时，民权团体表达的反对意见非常强烈。

sentences.en: National and local LGBT leaders took a stand in Philadelphia today, calling on senators to reject Trump's pick for attorney general.
sentences.zh: 全国和地方的LGBT领袖今天在费城表明立场，呼吁参议员拒绝特朗普提名的司法部长人选。

sentences.en: They say Senator Jeff Sessions has a track record of hostility towards LGBT people as well as other minorities.
sentences.zh: 他们说参议员杰夫·塞申斯对LGBT群体以及其他少数群体一贯怀有敌意。

sentences.en: And they all predicted that Sessions would usher in a dramatic rollback of what they saw as civil rights gains that were made under the Obama administration.
sentences.zh: 他们都预测塞申斯将导致奥巴马政府时期所取得的民权成果出现剧烈倒退。

sentences.en: Know this, that the Department of Justice and indeed the entire Obama administration want you to know
sentences.zh: 要知道，司法部乃至整个奥巴马政府都想让你知道，

sentences.en: that we see you, we stand with you, and we will do everything we can to protect you going forward.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了你们，我们与你们站在一起，我们将尽我们所能保护你们的未来。

sentences.en: And so there was this real fear among the civil rights groups that Jeff Sessions was going to walk all this back.
sentences.zh: 因此，民权团体中确实存在一种真正的恐惧，担心杰夫·塞申斯会推翻这一切。

sentences.en: And in many ways, those fears have been realized because very quickly...
sentences.zh: 在许多方面，这些担忧已经成为现实，因为很快……

sentences.en: The first rollback of the Obama administration's signature steps came just two weeks after Sessions'
sentences.zh: 奥巴马政府标志性举措的首次倒退发生在塞申斯确认任职仅两周后，

sentences.en: confirmation when the Justice Department joined the Department of Education to rescind guidance that
sentences.zh: 当时司法部与教育部联合撤销了一项指导方针，

sentences.en: instructed schools across the country to let transgender students use the bathroom of their choice.
sentences.zh: 该方针曾指示全国各地的学校允许跨性别学生使用他们选择的厕所。

sentences.en: The Justice Department has reversed an Obama-era policy that protects transgender workers against discrimination.
sentences.zh: 司法部推翻了一项保护跨性别员工免受歧视的奥巴马时代政策。

sentences.en: The move centers around...
sentences.zh: 这一举动集中在……

sentences.en: So if I'm understanding correctly, essentially, Sessions and the Trump administration has in fact rolled transgender protections back.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我理解正确的话，本质上，塞申斯和特朗普政府确实已经撤回了对跨性别者的保护。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是这样。

sentences.en: The Obama Justice Department viewed civil rights laws that said you can't discriminate against somebody based on sex.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马时期的司法部认为，民权法规定不能基于性别歧视某人。

sentences.en: They viewed that as saying gender identity is included in that.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这包含了性别认同。

sentences.en: Like how you interpret your own gender is wrapped up in that word sex.
sentences.zh: 就像你如何解读自己的性别被包含在“性别”这个词中一样。

sentences.en: That was their fair reading of the law.
sentences.zh: 那是他们对法律的公正解读。

sentences.en: And I think Jeff Sessions and his philosophy is you take a strict reading of the law.
sentences.zh: 而我认为杰夫·塞申斯和他的哲学是对法律进行严格解读。

sentences.en: And I think just in general, he believes that if Congress wants to expand the laws, they can expand the laws.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为总的来说，他相信如果国会想要扩大法律，他们可以扩大法律。

sentences.en: But he's not going to do that.
sentences.zh: 但他不会那样做。

sentences.en: And that's a philosophical difference.
sentences.zh: 这是一种哲学上的差异。

sentences.en: That's a legal difference.
sentences.zh: 这是一种法律上的差异。

sentences.en: And that's a big part of the change we've seen in the Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在司法部看到的巨大变化的一部分。

sentences.en: And what you feel about that is probably dictated based on what your politics is and what your sort of legal philosophy is.
sentences.zh: 你对此的感受可能取决于你的政治立场和你所持的法律哲学。

sentences.en: Matt, how do you make sense of the Justice Department's involvement in the Qadari Johnson case with that in mind?
sentences.zh: 马特，考虑到这一点，你如何理解司法部参与卡达里·约翰逊案？

sentences.en: I mean, again, back to this sort of, it's a whiplash for someone who's coming in from the outside, right?
sentences.zh: 我是说，回到这种感觉，对于一个从外部看的人来说，这就像是一种鞭打，对吧？

sentences.en: I don't think this is in conflict with the underlying Jeff Sessions philosophy.
sentences.zh: 我不认为这与杰夫·塞申斯潜在的哲学相冲突。

sentences.en: Good morning and thank you.
sentences.zh: 早上好，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Jeff Sessions actually gave a speech about the hate crimes in June at what was called the
sentences.zh: 杰夫·塞申斯实际上在六月份的一次演讲中谈到了仇恨犯罪，那次会议被称为

sentences.en: Hate Crime Summit in Washington.
sentences.zh: 华盛顿仇恨犯罪峰会。

sentences.en: The Trump administration and the Department of Justice are committed to reducing violent crime and hate crimes and making America safe.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府和司法部致力于减少暴力犯罪和仇恨犯罪，并使美国变得安全。

sentences.en: The takeaway line in that speech was, hate crimes are violent crimes.
sentences.zh: 那次演讲的中心思想是，仇恨犯罪就是暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: As you know, hate crimes are often precursors to violent crimes or indeed are violent crimes.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，仇恨犯罪往往是暴力犯罪的前兆，或者本身就是暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: And he really tied that back to the signature policy of his Justice Department, which is, we're going to get tough on violent crime.
sentences.zh: 他确实将其与他司法部的标志性政策联系起来，即我们要严厉打击暴力犯罪。

sentences.en: I've directed all our federal prosecutors to make violent crime prosecutions a top priority.
sentences.zh: 我已经指示我们所有的联邦检察官将暴力犯罪起诉作为首要任务。

sentences.en: And you can be sure that this includes hate crimes.
sentences.zh: 你可以肯定这包括仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: The Trump administration is very much, we're going to be the law and order Justice Department.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府非常强调我们要成为一个维护法律和秩序的司法部。

sentences.en: And Sessions framed hate crimes as part of that effort.
sentences.zh: 塞申斯将仇恨犯罪作为这一努力的一部分。

sentences.en: So we have and will continue to enforce hate crime laws aggressively and appropriately where transgendered individuals are victiMs.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们已经并将继续在跨性别个体成为受害者时，积极且适当地执行仇恨犯罪法。

sentences.en: Civil rights advocates, though, will be quick to tell you, like, this is the easy thing.
sentences.zh: 然而，民权倡导者会很快告诉你，这只是容易做到的事情。

sentences.en: Like, yes, we're very supportive of the Justice Department prosecuting hate crimes.
sentences.zh: 比如，是的，我们非常支持司法部起诉仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: But they will say, yeah, but it doesn't matter if you're not offering the protections against discrimination in the first place.
sentences.zh: 但他们会说，是的，但如果你一开始就不提供反歧视保护，那也没用。

sentences.en: And some people have gone so far as to make a link and say, by allowing discrimination against
sentences.zh: 有些人甚至更进一步，建立了一种联系，说通过允许基于性取向或性别认同的歧视，

sentences.en: people based on sexual orientation or gender identity, you are allowing the seeds of discrimination to blossom into, ultimately, violence directed at these groups.
sentences.zh: 你实际上是在允许歧视的种子最终演变成针对这些群体的暴力。

sentences.en: So we're talking about taking on individual cases, but not broader systemic protections around gender identity.
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论的是处理个别案件，而不是围绕性别认同的更广泛的系统性保护。

sentences.en: Yeah, correct.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: What was the outcome of the trial in Iowa in the murder of Qadari Johnson?
sentences.zh: 爱荷华州关于卡达里·约翰逊谋杀案的审判结果如何？

sentences.en: On Friday, November 3rd, the jury in Iowa came back unanimous that Jorge Sanders Galvez was guilty of murder.
sentences.zh: 11月3日星期五，爱荷华州的陪审团一致裁定豪尔赫·桑德斯·加尔韦斯谋杀罪名成立。
zh_words: 豪尔赫·桑德斯·加尔韦斯

sentences.en: And he's awaiting sentencing and I believe faces life in prison.
sentences.zh: 他正在等待判决，我相信他面临终身监禁。

sentences.en: Do you know what would cause the Department of Justice to pursue this at the federal level after the fact, after the state obtained a guilty verdict?
sentences.zh: 你知道是什么原因导致司法部在州政府获得有罪判决后，在联邦层面追究此案吗？

sentences.en: Sometimes the Justice Department will use these charges to make a statement.
sentences.zh: 有时司法部会利用这些指控来表明立场。

sentences.en: I don't necessarily see the Justice Department deciding it kind of needs to lean into this one.
sentences.zh: 我不一定认为司法部决定它需要倾向于这个案子。

sentences.en: But at the same time, Jeff Sessions has tried to send a message both with the speech by forming
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，杰夫·塞申斯试图通过演讲、组建调查未结跨性别谋杀案的小组，

sentences.en: this group to go and investigate unsolved transgender homicides and by making the decision to send, you know, a federal prosecutor out to Iowa.
sentences.zh: 以及决定派一名联邦检察官去爱荷华州，来传达一个信息。

sentences.en: All of these things send a message that I care about hate crimes.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都传达了一个信息，即我关心仇恨犯罪。

sentences.en: And I guess wrapped up in that is I'm not the two-dimensional guy that civil rights groups made me out to be.
sentences.zh: 我想其中也包含着我不是民权团体所描述的那种二维人物。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I'm quite sure that that in and of itself is not going to change his image with civil rights groups.
sentences.zh: 我很确定这本身并不会改变他在民权团体眼中的形象。

sentences.en: Before I actually close this up in prayer, let's say a prayer together.
sentences.zh: 在我结束祷告之前，让我们一起做一个祷告。

sentences.en: I'm sure most of you know the Lord's Prayer.
sentences.zh: 我相信你们大多数人都知道主祷文。

sentences.en: Will you join me as we say that?
sentences.zh: 你们愿意和我一起念吗？

sentences.en: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name.
sentences.zh: 我们在天上的父，愿人都尊你的名为圣。

sentences.en: Thy kingdom come, thy will be done.
sentences.zh: 愿你的国降临，愿你的旨意行在地上。

sentences.en: Monica, it's been over a year since Qadari was killed.
sentences.zh: 莫妮卡，卡达里被杀已经一年多了。

sentences.en: How do people in Burlington remember him?
sentences.zh: 伯灵顿的人们是如何记住他的？

sentences.en: How do they want him to be remembered?
sentences.zh: 他们希望人们如何记住他？

sentences.en: I think that you listen to some of them, they talk about what he wanted to do.
sentences.zh: 我想如果你听听他们中的一些人，他们会谈论他想做什么。

sentences.en: Maybe he was going to be a counselor.
sentences.zh: 也许他会成为一名咨询师。

sentences.en: Maybe he would have a TV show.
sentences.zh: 也许他会有一个电视节目。

sentences.en: They had ideas about who he was going to be, but I'm not sure they see him as a big symbol.
sentences.zh: 他们对他的未来有想法，但我不太确定他们是否把他看作一个伟大的象征。

sentences.en: I think, I don't think they see him that way at all, actually.
sentences.zh: 我想，事实上，我不认为他们是那样看他的。

sentences.en: I think they sort of see him as Qadari was just Qadari.
sentences.zh: 我想他们只是觉得卡达里就是卡达里。

sentences.en: And people accepted him for that.
sentences.zh: 人们接受他本来的样子。

sentences.en: He would make it a point to walk by my house, you know, and I would ignore him like I didn't see him.
sentences.zh: 他会特意从我家门前走过，你知道，我会假装没看见他，不理他。

sentences.en: And he would make sure that I would have to see him and say something to him.
sentences.zh: 但他会确保我必须看到他，并对他说些什么。

sentences.en: My kids would be outside.
sentences.zh: 我的孩子们会在外面。

sentences.en: He'd holler at them and they'd be like, mom, here comes Qadari down the street again.
sentences.zh: 他会冲他们大喊，他们就会说，妈妈，卡达里又顺着街走过来了。

sentences.en: You know, they would be like a big announcement because he's putting on a show coming down that street to make sure that everybody knew he was coming.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们会像发布重大新闻一样，因为他走在街上就像在表演，确保每个人都知道他来了。

sentences.en: And, you know, and just like, he knew where he was doing and he knew where he was going in life.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，他知道自己在做什么，也知道自己的人生方向。

sentences.en: That's for sure.
sentences.zh: 那是肯定的。

sentences.en: So when it comes down to things like Jeff Sessions, I think they're puzzled.
sentences.zh: 所以当涉及到像杰夫·塞申斯这样的事情时，我想他们感到困惑。

sentences.en: But I also think they're really more worried about, you know, what happened to Qadari.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们更担心的是，你知道，卡达里身上发生的事情。

sentences.en: So Lord, we know that justice will be carried out.
sentences.zh: 所以主啊，我们知道正义终将得到伸张。

sentences.en: We pray that justice will be carried out here on this earth by whatever law enforcement officers may bring light towards this terrible crime.
sentences.zh: 我们祈祷正义能在这片土地上得到伸张，无论执法人员如何为这起可怕的罪行带来光明。

sentences.en: But Lord, we know ultimately that you will carry out justice.
sentences.zh: 但主啊，我们深知您最终必会伸张正义。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And we thank you for that.
sentences.zh: 我们为此感谢您。

sentences.en: And we remember Qadari in our hearts and our minds because of this.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，我们将卡达里铭记在心。

sentences.en: In Jesus' name we pray.
sentences.zh: 奉耶稣之名祈祷。

sentences.en: Amen.
sentences.zh: 阿门。

sentences.en: I just want to say that the Maple Leaf Center is open.
sentences.zh: 我只想说枫叶中心现已开放。

sentences.en: You're welcome.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是您今天还需要了解的消息。

sentences.en: The Texas gunman who killed 26 people inside a church on Sunday had escaped from a psychiatric
sentences.zh: 周日在那座教堂枪杀26人的德克萨斯州枪手，曾于2012年从一家精神病院逃脱，

sentences.en: hospital in 2012 after getting caught trying to smuggle weapons onto an Air Force base and threatening his superiors.
sentences.zh: 此前他因试图将武器走私到空军基地并威胁上级而被捕。

sentences.en: The incident occurred the same year that the gunman, Devin Kelly, was charged with assaulting his wife and baby stepson, charges to which he later pleaded guilty.
sentences.zh: 就在同一年，这名枪手德文·凯利被指控袭击其妻子和继子，他后来对这些指控供认不讳。

sentences.en: According to a police report at the time of his escape, Kelly was, quote, a danger to himself and others.
sentences.zh: 根据他逃跑时的警方报告，凯利被描述为“对自己和他人构成危险”。

sentences.en: And I am grateful and proud to accept the responsibility you have given to me to serve as the next governor of the great state of New Jersey.
sentences.zh: 我怀着感激与自豪之情，接受你们赋予我的重任，担任新泽西州下一任州长。

sentences.en: Very big night, a very big night for Democrats in key states right now.
sentences.zh: 今晚对民主党人来说是一个非常重要的夜晚，在几个关键州都是如此。

sentences.en: Let's take a closer look.
sentences.zh: 让我们仔细看看。

sentences.en: Whether you voted for me or not, we are all Virginians.
sentences.zh: 无论你们是否投票给我，我们都是弗吉尼亚人。

sentences.en: A historically large margin of victory for a Democratic gubernatorial candidate in Virginia.
sentences.zh: 这是弗吉尼亚州民主党州长候选人历史上以巨大优势取得的胜利。

sentences.en: Governor-elect calling this a repudiation of the Trump administration down in Washington.
sentences.zh: 当选州长称这是对华盛顿特朗普政府的否定。

sentences.en: You know, if I'm a suburban House Republican right now, I'm a little nervous.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果我现在是一名郊区的共和党众议员，我会感到有点紧张。

sentences.en: This is what a wave feels like.
sentences.zh: 这就是浪潮来袭的感觉。

sentences.en: And Democrats won tonight because Donald Trump is president.
sentences.zh: 民主党今晚获胜是因为唐纳德·特朗普担任总统。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: Michael Barbaro will be back tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴巴罗明天会回来。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》节目，我们将为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否喝到断片才能入睡。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的需求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《Wirecutter秀》。
